verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only that Elasticsearch returns a BM25 relevance score for search hits (elastic-probe-rt-2), confirming scores are visible, but there is no documentation of Elasticsearch's explain/profile capabilities that break down why a document scored as it did. Missing for 10: explicit mention of the _explain or _profile APIs, docs on explaining hybrid/RRF ranking, and any hands-on example of inspecting a full scoring breakdown.
